dct_title_s: Map of the Sixth Commissioner's District in St. Louis County Minnesota
dct_description_sm: Topographic map of the area between Mountain Iron in the west, the eastern edge of St. Louis county in the east, Markham in the south, and Embarrass in the north. Features handwritten notation by Ray Segar in red pencil regarding logging railroads in the area.
